events.name: San Francisco 49ers at St. Louis Rams

headlines.description: Colin Kaepernick threw two touchdown passes, Frank Gore had his first 100-yard game of the season and the San Francisco 49ers' defense stepped up without some of their stars in a 35-11 rout over the St. Louis Rams on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Niners get back on track behind Gore, defense

headlines.description: Bills hang on for 23-20 win over Ravens
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills use 5 picks off Flacco to upend Ravens

headlines.description: Brian Hoyer, the local kid who always dreamed of being Cleveland's quarterback, threw two touchdown passes in his first start at home to lead the Browns to a 17-6 win over the Cincinnati Bengals on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hoyer guides hometown Browns by Bengals

headlines.description: Reggie Bush's 37-yard touchdown run helped Detroit score 27 points in the second quarter and he accounted for 173 yards of offense to help the Lions beat the Chicago Bears 40-32 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bush leads Lions past turnover-plagued Bears

events.name: New York Giants at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Alex Smith threw three touchdown passes, Dexter McCluster returned a punt 89 yards for another score and the unbeaten Kansas City Chiefs plunged the New York Giants to 0-4 with a 31-7 victory on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs remain unbeaten, drop Giants to 0-4

headlines.description: Greg Jennings made two touchdown catches, Adrian Peterson ran for two scores and the Vikings' defense made a big stop with time running out to preserve a 34-27 win over the Steelers on Sunday for their first win of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings hold off Steelers for win in London

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Carson Palmer threw a 13-yard touchdown pass to Larry Fitzgerald, then Jay Feely kicked a 27-yard field goal with 1:29 remaining as the Arizona Cardinals rallied to beat the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 13-10 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cardinals edge Bucs on Peterson's two INTs

headlines.description: Andrew Luck threw two touchdown passes, Trent Richardson ran for a score and the Indianapolis Colts became the latest to beat the Jacksonville Jaguars by double digits with a 37-3 win Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luck, Colts hand Jags another lopsided loss

headlines.description: Steven Hauschka kicked a 45-yard field goal in overtime to give the Seattle Seahawks a 23-20 win over the Houston Texans on Sunday and the first 4-0 start in franchise history.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks still perfect, drop Texans in OT

events.name: New York Jets at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: Jake Locker threw a career-high three touchdowns before being taken to the hospital with an injured right hip, and the Tennessee Titans beat the New York Jets 38-13 for their second straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans wallop Jets but lose Locker to injury

headlines.description: The Denver Broncos scored more points than they ever had in their 54-year history Sunday, blowing out the Philadelphia Eagles 52-20 behind Peyton Manning's four touchdown throws.
headlines.shortLinkText: Peyton (4 TDs), Broncos pour 52 on Eagles
Redskins lean on D, beat Raiders for 1st win

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Philip Rivers threw for 401 yards and three touchdowns, including a 56-yarder to Antonio Gates, and the San Diego Chargers rallied to beat the Dallas Cowboys 30-21 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chargers score final 20, knock off Cowboys

events.name: New England Patriots at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw for 316 yards and two touchdowns as the New England Patriots held off a furious Atlanta comeback Sunday night, beating the Falcons 30-23 to improve to 4-0 for the first time since their near-perfect season in 2007.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pats survive Falcons' late rally to reach 4-0

events.name: Miami Dolphins at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Drew Brees passed for 413 yards and four touchdowns, and the Saints turned a clash of unbeaten teams into a lopsided affair, beating the Miami Dolphins 38-17 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brees tosses 4 TDs as Saints slug Dolphins
